feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is the iteration 4 design (best raced, 53.7076: kd 0.15, ki 0, kp 1.5, x = +/-0.03 with 16 mm footprints) with two changes: base_speed goes from 1.4 to 1.25, and line_loss is back to last_direction. The line_loss change is a revert, not a new test: iteration 5 (search_right) matched iteration 4 to four decimal places on all three tracks, so recovery direction has no measured effect. The speed change is the only variable not yet isolated. The 1.6 baseline in iteration 0 was run with kp 2.0, kd 0.05 and 12 mm footprints, so it never tested speed alone. Every race so far has ended off track on all 60 trials with one line-loss event each and max_error of about 0.060 to 0.065 m. The geometry (iteration 2) and ki (iteration 3) changes did not help, and kd 0.15 (iteration 4) gave only a small gain. The off-track limit cannot be raised with body_width (iteration 5 analysis), so the excursion has to be reduced by the controller or by speed. The candidate is valid, differs from the best raced design only by base_speed, and is cheap to race. Racing it gives the speed evidence the next critique needs, and the iteration has enough runs left for one more revision if the race points to a clear fix. Next-race guidance: (a) If max_error falls to 0.06 m or below, or line_loss_events drops to 0 or 1 on some seeds, keep base_speed 1.25 and check whether progress and completion_time improve. (b) If max_error and line_loss_events are unchanged (about 0.060 to 0.065 m, one loss per trial), speed is not the limit. Restore base_speed 1.4 and test kp 2.0 with kd 0.15 as a single change, to see whether stiffer steering corrects the drift before the 0.05 m loss. (c) If progress falls below about 0.11 with no reduction in line loss, the slower speed costs more than it gains, so revert to 1.4.
requested_changes: If max_error falls to 0.06 m or below, or line_loss_events falls to 0 or 1, keep controller.base_speed = 1.25 and check progress and completion_time against iteration 4 (progress 0.11 to 0.16, no completions) before any further change.

If max_error stays at about 0.060 to 0.065 m with one loss per trial, set controller.base_speed back to 1.4 and test controller.kp = 2.0 with kd = 0.15 and ki = 0 as a single change. Iteration 0 is the only kp 2.0 run and it had a different kd and footprint, so this has not been tested cleanly.
If progress falls below about 0.11 with no drop in line-loss events, revert controller.base_speed to 1.4, since the slower run is losing distance without reducing the excursion.
